results.author: fladyck
results.body_snippet: 被测提交：`1cb5a782711bc4c68b6ddcc7476a8293a806dbc6`。真实 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 / Node 24.21.0 / Windows 10 19045。 移除插件后，三条 `/plugins/dsh-files/attachments*` 路由仍返回原数据；重新加载把下载上限改为 1 字节后，21 字节附件仍下载成功（200，预期 413）。日志出现 duplicate exact route，被捕获为 warn，而插件 fiber 仍 active。 根因：registerAttachmentRoutes 丢弃三次 webServer.register 返回的 disposer；真实宿主 register 仅操作注册表，未自动随 fiber 清理。将 disposer 纳入调用注入 fiber 的 ctx.effect 后，同一探针得到移除后 404、重载后 413。 边界：同进程热移除/重载；不主张重启整个 DSH 后残留。真实 Loader/WebServer/LocalAttachmentStore；tools、fs、system

results.title: Form body serialization flattens array values
results.author: DaltonTheDeveloper
results.body_snippet: Form-urlencoded request bodies flatten array values into a single comma-joined field instead of repeating the key. - `serializeBody({ events: ["a", "b"] })` should produce `events[]=a&events[]=b`, but currently produces `events=a,b`. - Scalar fields like `{ name: "x" }` already serialize correctly. **Squash bounty.** A frozen acceptance test lives at `.squash/acceptance.test.mjs` and currently fails on the base commit. results.title: Run pin endpoint treats string false as pinned
results.author: rishibalanagu0108
results.body_snippet: ### What happened `POST /api/runs/:traceId/pin` stores `b.pinned !== false`. Runtime JSON such as `{"pinned":"false"}` therefore pins the run instead of unpinning it and returns 200. ### Expected Require a JSON boolean and return 400 for other types. Valid `true` and `false` requests retain their current behavior. ### Version Current `main` at `9d1c11e`.

results.title: Chat creation treats string false permission flags as true
results.author: rishibalanagu0108
results.body_snippet: ### What happened `POST /api/chat/sessions` passes `allow_edits` and `allow_commands` directly to `AgentChats.create`, which coerces them with `!!`. Runtime JSON such as `{"allow_commands":"false"}` therefore grants command access instead of disabling it. ### Expected Each supplied permission flag must be a JSON boolean. Malformed values return 400 before the session is created; valid booleans remain unchanged. ### Version Current `main` at `9d1c11e`.

results.title: Check enable endpoint treats string false as enabled
results.author: rishibalanagu0108
results.body_snippet: ### What happened `POST /api/checks/:id/enabled` stores `b.enabled !== false`. Runtime JSON is not type-checked, so `{"enabled":"false"}` and every other non-boolean value enable the check and return 200. ### Expected Require a JSON boolean and return 400 for any other supplied type. Valid `true` and `false` requests remain unchanged. ### Version Current `main` at `9d1c11e`.

results.title: parse_duration drops the days (d) unit
results.author: tine1117
results.body_snippet: ## Bug `parse_duration` silently drops the **days** (`d`) unit. The README lists `d` as a supported unit, but the parser ignores it and returns a wrong (too-small) result instead of raising or counting it. ### Reproduction ```python from duration_utils import parse_duration parse_duration("1d") # -> 0 (expected 86400) parse_duration("2d4h") # -> 14400 (expected 187200) ``` ### Expected `d` should be counted as 86400 seconds, so `parse_duration("1d") == 86400` and `parse_duration("2d4h") == 18720
